data.name: Ghost Bros
data.detailed_description:
Ghost Bros is a 1–4 player co-op ghost-investigation simulation where you and your crew search for proof of the supernatural... and stream it for profit! Travel to real haunted destinations, use Ghost Bros-branded equipment, and build your online following while trying not to anger the entities you uncover.

Features

• Full Twitch integration:
Let your Twitch viewers interact with you in real time! Viewers can vote on objectives, like who investigates a room alone or who taunts the ghost, and even trigger in-game events. Control exactly how they interact with robust options such as subscriber-only events, in-game commercial breaks, and special audience rewards.

• Unique team roles:
Play as different ghost hunting professions, each with their own investigative advantages:
Investigator, Medium, and Technician.

• Stream Manager mode:
Too scared to go in? No problem. Manage the team from a safe distance with streamer-friendly tools to operate cameras, switch feeds, and oversee the chaos. Perfect for real-life streamers and content creators. Stream Managers can also direct CPU controlled investigators to help out with the investigation.

• Single Player Option:
Add CPU-controlled Ghost Bros who will automatically investigate with you. Use voice commands to instruct them to various team functions like repair cameras, unlock doors, and investigate rooms.

• Real haunted locations:
Unlock and explore real-world haunted sites such as the Pacific Northwest Shanghai Tunnels, each with its own mysteries and restless spirits.

Whether you’re in it for the money, the fame, or to help those plagued by the paranormal—you’re the only thing standing between us and what goes bump in the night.
Join Ghost Bros today!

Thank you for making our Kickstarter such an amazing success!
